role: Generated recipe registry: CraftingManager.getRecipeList() in list order (317 recipes: shaped, shapeless and the special armor-dye, book-cloning, map-cloning, map-extending and fireworks kinds), their 1626 ingredient stacks, FurnaceRecipes' smelting list and experience list (22 each), and the constants the special recipes read (leather armor materials, fleece colours, dye colours, dye-to-fleece map, item ids). Generated by netherite.oracle.RecipeTable from the live oracle; not edited by hand.

structs.name: recipe_def
structs.java: IRecipe: ShapedRecipes/ShapelessRecipes or a special recipe class

structs.name: smelting_def
structs.java: one FurnaceRecipes smeltingList or experienceList entry

notes: Pure static const data, no functions. Included by crafting.h and read by crafting.c and smelting.c. Floats are hex literals of the raw bits. The per-entry comments name Java objects by identity hash (e.g. ItemMultiTexture@3e96bacf), which changes if the table is regenerated. Regenerate with oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/RecipeTable.java.
